findings.title: Parameterize bare dict annotations
findings.problem: The new module annotates build_spending_metric -> dict (line 49), build_spending_metrics(spending_data: dict | None) -> list[dict] (line 76) and paginate_tabular(columns: list[dict], rows: list[dict], filters_applied: dict) -> dict (lines 160-166) with bare dict. code-quality.md (Types And Imports) lists bare list/dict annotations under Avoid and parameterized generics under Prefer. The signatures are verbatim from BASE _spending_support.py, but the module is new to service/analytics/ and these are its public functions.
findings.impact: New public service-layer signatures miss the documented type-hint standard (blocking code-quality standards_review partial). Annotations are strings under `from __future__ import annotations`, so runtime behavior is unaffected; reachability is not applicable to a static annotation.
findings.recommendation: Use dict[str, Any] for metric and response dicts and for filters_applied, list[dict[str, Any]] for columns and rows, and dict[str, Any] | None for spending_data (Any is already imported). Annotations only; bodies stay unchanged. The handoff bodycheck compares ast.dump including annotations, so relax that comparison for these three signatures and record the deviation in HANDOFF.md.
